g.text: Ralph loop: one RB task per iteration, mechanical done-gate
Any runner can drive it. TASKS.md and PROGRESS.md live in packages/backend-rs, so a fresh agent has zero hidden state.
read PROGRESS.md, take the first unchecked task,
one line per RB task: id, title,
vp run rb:gate · iteration lane (target < 6 min warm)
Path-scope check: the gate fails if the iteration touched packages/backend/src/__tests__/**, parity/**/allowlist*, scripts/rb-gate*
or another task's checkbox, unless the task's Scope lists that path (stops agents from "fixing" the oracle).
vp run rb:gate:full · nightly + PR CI
Spin guard: after 2 consecutive GATE: fail on one task,
the runner marks the task blocked in PROGRESS.md
and moves on to the next task
Spin guard: the runner retries the gate
